question: What auspicious knowledge about the deception of time does the speaker now wish to hear?
premises: The speaker now wishes to hear something.
The object is the deception of time.
That deception is described as auspicious to hear.
inference: The speaker now wishes to hear the auspicious account of the deception of time.
uncertainties: The content of that account is not given in this verse.
plain_english: Now I wish to hear the auspicious deception of time.
